tools.name: sense_location
tools.description: Return current physical-world evidence and historical forecast reliability for a coordinate. Every available value keeps its provenance, distance, age, measured/predicted status and confidence; source divergence is reported. Required but unavailable evidence is named, never silently estimated.

tools.name: check_operability
tools.description: Decision support for an activity at a coordinate, including historical forecast reliability when established. tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the operational domains accepted by Senlay and a brief of the evidence and threshold logic each domain uses. Actual thresholds and assessments always come from Senlay Core.

tools.name: get_forecast_trust
tools.description: Return historical forecast reliability at a coordinate, separately for wind speed and direction.
